transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... I guess I'm just here because my appetite has been off lately. For the last few weeks, I've barely had one. Even the food I usually like after a shift... it just sits there. I just sort of force down a few bites. That's really it.
Have you lost any weight over the last few weeks?
I haven't really checked a scale. Um... maybe? Like I said, I just... I barely have an appetite right now. I'm mostly just forcing down those few bites, so... probably.
Have you noticed any change in how your clothes fit?
Yeah, I guess my uniform pants are a little looser. But... like I said, I'm just not really eating. Just forcing down those few bites after my shift. So... yeah. They fit a bit different.
Are you trying to lose weight?
No. I'm not trying to. Like I said, it's just... I barely have an appetite. Even the stuff I usually get after a shift, I just look at it and... force down a few bites. That's all.
Do you feel like you're eating less because you want to or because you're just not hungry?
Just... not hungry. Like I keep saying, the appetite just isn't there. I'll get something I usually like and it just... sits in front of me. I just don't want it.
Are you worried about the weight loss you've experienced?

I don't know if "worried" is the right word. But... I guess it is why I came in. Just because for the last few weeks, I've barely had an appetite at all. Like I've been saying, I just sit there staring at my food. So... I just wanted to see what's going on, I guess.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?
No. I'm not... it's not about that. Like I said, I just... don't want to eat.
Do you think you would be upset if you gained weight?
No... I don't think so. I really wouldn't care. Like I said, it's just... I just don't have an appetite. That's all it is.
Have you been feeling sad or depressed lately?

I guess... I don't know about sad. It's more just... this heavy, flat feeling. I've been carrying it around most days. Like, even if I'm home with the family, or just sitting in the break room at work... I just feel like I'm not really there.
Have you been enjoying activities or hobbies that you usually like?

Not really. I used to... I don't know, look forward to my morning runs. Or playing guitar, cooking dinner, stuff like that. But lately I just keep skipping them. They just feel like chores now. I just... can't really get myself to care about doing them.
Have you lost more than 5% of your body weight over the last month?
I don't know. I haven't really been on a scale lately... I don't think it's been that much.
Do you feel hopeless about the future?
I don't know... I haven't really thought about it much. Just taking it one shift at a time, I guess. I wouldn't say I feel hopeless.
Have you noticed any significant change in your body weight since your appetite decreased?

Like I said, I'm not really sure about the weight part. But... yeah, for the last few weeks I've barely had an appetite. I'll get home from a shift, and even if it's food I usually like... it just sits there. I kind of just force down a few bites and that's about it.
Have you lost a noticeable amount of weight since your appetite started decreasing?
I just... I really don't know. Like I mentioned, I haven't been checking my weight. I just know I haven't been eating much.
Have you had anyone comment on how much weight you've lost recently?
No, not really. People at work don't really pay attention to that kind of thing. So... no one's said anything to me.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight since your appetite decreased?

Look... I don't know how else to answer that. Like I keep saying, I really have no idea about the weight. I just know what I told you before. For the last few weeks, I barely have an appetite. I get off my shift, food I usually like just sits there, and I force down a couple of bites. That's all I can tell you.
Are you frightened by the idea of gaining weight?
No. It's nothing like that. I'm not scared of gaining weight... I just don't want to eat.
Do you feel like you're depressed?
I guess... yeah. Most days I just feel... flat. Like I'm carrying this heavy feeling around. Even when I'm home, or just sitting in the break room at work... I'm just not really there.
Do you think your weight or body shape is a problem?
No. I don't really think about it. It's just... I just don't have an appetite, that's all.
Have you experienced any significant weight loss along with your feelings of depression?

I haven't really checked my weight. But... yeah, that's kind of why I came in. For the last few weeks, I've just barely had an appetite. Even food I usually like to grab after a shift... it just sits there. I mostly just force down a few bites and call it good.
